spec.title: Service Health
spec.description: Overall scrape health for Parquet Writer. If any Parquet Writer target is unavailable, this shows Down.

spec.title: Consumers Running
spec.description: Number of Parquet Writer consumer workers currently reporting running. Expected value is 3.

spec.title: Consumer Speed
spec.description: Current Kafka consumption speed across Parquet Writer consumers.

spec.title: Estimated Kafka Delay
spec.description: Worst estimated consumer backlog drain time: total assigned lag divided by the matching consumer's actual 15-minute throughput. This is not event-time latency.

spec.title: Write Errors (5m)
spec.description: Write operations reported as failed by Parquet Writer during the last 5 minutes. The metric indicates that a write failed; it does not identify the downstream root cause.

spec.title: DLQ Records (5m)
spec.description: Invalid or unserializable records sent to the dead-letter queue during the last 5 minutes.

spec.title: Pipeline Throughput
spec.description: Compares records consumed from Kafka with records successfully written by Parquet Writer. A sustained gap helps identify loss of throughput inside the ingester.

spec.title: Kafka Delay by Partition
spec.description: Estimated backlog drain time for each partition, using the matching consumer's actual 15-minute throughput. Duplicate scrape/instance series are collapsed so each partition appears once.

spec.title: Time Since Last Batch Closed
spec.description: Time since each consumer last successfully closed/finalized its current batch. If this keeps rising instead of resetting, batch processing may be stuck.

spec.title: Current Batch Age
spec.description: How long the currently open batch has been collecting records for each consumer.

spec.title: Batch Flush Time
spec.description: Average time needed to finalize and flush a batch. Rising values mean batch completion is taking longer.

spec.title: Why Batches Closed
spec.description: Number of batch-close events in the selected time range, grouped by what triggered them. Colors are fixed by reason so the categories remain consistent across refreshes: size, time-bucket boundary, age, record count, and lifecycle.

spec.title: Completed Parquet Files
spec.description: Individual Parquet files successfully committed to their final HDFS paths since the current pods started.

spec.title: Records per Poll
spec.description: Average number of Kafka records returned to each consumer every time it polls Kafka. This shows how much work each poll is delivering; it is different from records/sec.

spec.title: Parquet Writer Module
spec.description: Operational dashboard for Parquet Writer service health, Kafka consumption speed and delay, write errors, DLQ activity, throughput, and batch behavior.
